highlights.label: 793 m of wall. no way in

note: 1 — 793 m of exterior wall with not one opening in it, which `arch lint` reports as W_NO_ENTRANCE: both teams start the round already inside. 2 — Mid, Long and B Doors are the only doors; the other 18 thresholds are cased openings. 3 — a stacked crate is two crates in one place on a horizontal cut, and the machine fix would delete the boost.
